bifrost: springboard/apps/daw/src/compose.rs (midi(), pitches()), springboard/apps/daw/src/dsp.rs (mtof), springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs (Bluetooth management socket, audio-class devices only)
summary: The MIDI stack exists as pure models with host unit tests: UMP and MIDI 1.0 messages, an endpoint registry and routing hub, thru transforms, BLE MIDI packets, MIDI-CI discovery and Property Exchange, and RTP-MIDI session packets. None of it is wired into the shell or apps or verified on Midget, and there is no MIDI driver. Note-number math in the DAW is one small use of it.

features.feature: MIDI Services (clients, ports, device and entity lookup)
features.apple: MIDIClientCreate, MIDIInputPortCreateWithProtocol, MIDIOutputPortCreate, MIDIGetNumberOfDevices, MIDIPortConnectSource, MIDIReceiveBlock (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coremidi/midi-services)
features.bifrost: springboard/audio/midi/src/endpoints.rs (Registry: clients, devices, entities, endpoints, connections), springboard/audio/midi/src/hub.rs (routing), springboard/audio/midid/ (ALSA rawmidi and seq, BLE link)
features.note: Pure models with host unit tests: client and endpoint registry, virtual endpoints, connect_source, and a routing hub with stable timestamp ordering. The midid daemon crate describes ALSA rawmidi and seq and BLE links, not yet verified on the VM or Midget. Not wired into apps or the shell. No app-facing API for device I/O in the SDK beyond the existing MIDI module. Built on parity/team-n-core-midi; not yet verified on Midget.

features.feature: MIDI System Setup (driver and external device management)
features.note: Pure model with host unit tests: external devices, entities and endpoints in the registry, with removal. No hotplug event source and no driver list; the Linux side (ALSA) is described by the midid crate but not verified. Not wired into apps or the shell. Built on parity/team-n-core-midi; not yet verified on Midget.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/midi_ble.rs (SysExAssembler); springboard/audio/midi/src/ble.rs (BLE MIDI packet framing); springboard/sdk/src/ble_midi.rs; springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-09.rs
features.note: BLE MIDI packet encode and decode with timestamps and MTU splitting (audio/midi/src/ble.rs), and SysExAssembler joins system exclusive messages that span packets, both tested headless. The system layer pairs and tracks Bluetooth devices and classifies audio-class devices. Gap: GATT service discovery on the live link is not verified, and it needs a Bluetooth peripheral on the lab machine.

features.apple: MIDI1UPNoteOn, MIDI1UPControlChange, MIDI2NoteOn, MIDI2PitchBend, MIDIMessage_32, MIDIMessage_64 (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coremidi/midi-messages)
features.bifrost: springboard/audio/midi/src/ump.rs (UMP and MIDI 1.0 conversion, SysEx), springboard/audio/midi/src/events.rs (MIDI 1.0 parser and encoder), springboard/apps/daw/src/model.rs:152 (note struct)
features.note: Universal MIDI Packets with MIDI 1.0 and 2.0 channel voice, system, 64-bit and 128-bit data, SysEx assembly, and conversion to and from MIDI 1.0 bytes (ump.rs), with host unit tests. The DAW note model still stores only pitch and velocity. Not yet wired to a device or verified on Midget. Built on parity/team-n-core-midi; not yet verified on Midget.

features.feature: Note number to pitch and frequency
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 13 tests. Covers note names (C#4, Bb2) to note numbers and note numbers to Hz. The per-note attribute types (pitch, manufacturer-specific, profile-specific) have no counterpart.

features.feature: MIDI Thru Connection (play-through, value maps, transforms)
features.bifrost: springboard/audio/midi/src/thru.rs (ValueMap, ControlTransform, ThruConnection), springboard/audio/midi/src/hub.rs (routing between sources and destinations)
features.note: Thru connection with parameters and enable state, value maps (identity, table, linear), control transforms, and routing through the hub, with host unit tests. Not wired into apps or the shell, and not yet verified on Midget. Built on parity/team-n-core-midi; not yet verified on Midget.

Sprint 3: NetworkSession, Host, Connection, ConnectionPolicy and RTP-MIDI session packets (IN, OK, NO, BY) with host unit tests; no sockets or mDNS discovery, not wired into the shell, not yet checked on Midget.

features.feature: MIDI Drivers (driver plug-ins and device lists)
features.note: The Apple driver plug-in model is specific to macOS. The Linux counterpart would be the kernel ALSA sequencer, which BifrOSt does not use for MIDI.

features.feature: MIDI Capability Inquiry (MIDI-CI discovery, profiles, property exchange)
features.note: Sprint 3: MIDI-CI 1.1 discovery, invalidate MUID and profile inquiry/set/enabled messages, DiscoveryManager, Device and Profile, with host unit tests. Property Exchange messages (capabilities, Get and Set Property Data) with chunk split and in-order reassembly, with host unit tests (parity/team-n-core-midi). No transport, no subscription messages, not yet checked on Midget.

gaps: Not verified on Midget or the VM: the MIDI models are not yet wired to a live device path (ALSA rawmidi and seq, BLE GATT) or to an app.
No MIDI-CI subscription messages and no transport for Property Exchange; no property exchange over SysEx packets on a live link.
No MIDI network sockets or mDNS discovery; the RTP-MIDI session packets are not sent or received.
No USB or hardware MIDI hotplug event path into the endpoint registry (the midid daemon describes it; not verified).
The DAW note model stores only pitch and velocity (springboard/apps/daw/src/model.rs:152); control change and pitch bend are not used by the DAW.
No app-facing SDK API for MIDI beyond the protocol modules in springboard/sdk/src/midi*.rs.
